about.text: Plaintiff Deliris Montanez Berrios, appearing pro se, appeals the district court’s denial of her second Fed. R. Civ. P. 60(b) motion to reopen the case. Plaintiff also moves for an injunction pending appeal to preserve election-related records and for expedited consideration of that motion.
